body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-01-29 (Q3FY26 concall transcript): "certainly an overall growth of anything between 21%, 22% is on the cards for the full year. Again, the 25% is -- was our aspirational growth for the full year." Metric: Consolidated revenue growth YoY. Target: +20-22% FY26; Q4FY26 +25-30% YoY. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: range; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: delivered. Evidence: FY26 +20.1% (inside ~20-22%, ratio 0.96 vs the 21% midpoint-low). Q4FY26 revenue 1,666 cr = +29.4% YoY, inside the 25-30% said.
